summary: The patch addresses a specific issue with model options not being cleared during migration squashing but may have some minor concerns regarding test coverage and documentation.

issues.description: There are no additional tests specifically addressing the scenario where options should be cleared. While the existing tests pass, more targeted tests could ensure the fix is robust.
The change lacks a comment explaining why the options are being cleared and how this resolves the issue. Adding a brief comment would improve readability and maintainability.
